Root IDs of neurons at another time

octo_ids_at.Rd

Shows what neurons were (or became) at a given time: for each root ID, a sample of its supervoxels is looked up at timestamp. Supervoxels never change, so this works for current and outdated IDs, and in both directions in time. A neuron that was assembled by merges since then maps to several earlier pieces; the largest is returned as id_at.

Usage

octo_ids_at(ids, timestamp, sample = 200L, details = FALSE)

Arguments

ids

root IDs (character)

timestamp

POSIXct, Date or text such as "2026-11-01 14:00" (read as UTC unless it has an offset)

sample

supervoxels sampled per neuron

details

return a data.frame with all pieces instead of a vector

Value

character vector of root IDs at timestamp ("0" if the neuron's supervoxels belonged to no neuron then), or a data.frame with id, id_at, fraction (share of sampled supervoxels in id_at), n_pieces and pieces

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
octo_ids_at(octo_find_ids("^KC"), "2026-10-01")
octo_ids_at("720575940...", as.POSIXct("2026-11-20 09:00", tz = "Europe/Berlin"),
            details = TRUE)
} # }
